(a) Through Interactive Voice Response (IVR): Step – 1. On receipt of request from the consumer through IVR, the service provider shall provide to the consumer, over the recorded IVR, the choice of language for interaction, which shall be in English, Hindi and in the regional language; Step – 2. The consumer is given an option to select the activation or deactivation of data service by pressing the appropriate key for the service to be activated or deactivated; Step – 3. On pressing the appropriate key, an SMS shall be delivered to the consumer informing him that his request has been received and the service shall be activated or deactivated, as the case may be, within four hours and that he shall receive an SMS confirming action taken on his request; Step – 4.
